card.name: Mixed spots in prescribing-information text
card.fires_on: No single word type. It fires on scattered spots in drug-label text: digits in cross-references or ranges, a letter inside a word, and some commas.
card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly pharmaceutical-company terms in English and Chinese, which does not fit the contexts well.
card.plain: It lights up at assorted spots in drug-label text, such as numbers and word pieces, with no pattern a reader could rely on.
